propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' on Python 3.11 when running test_opcert_service_app.py, blocking CI gate with spurious Verified -1

CPython issue 86296 causes asyncio.wait_for to consume external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker task in cancelling state at queue.get() while lifespan shutdown awaits indefinitely

Pre-fix code using asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=...) hangs or fails on py3.11 with 'worker ignored shutdown cancellation' assertion; post-fix using async with asyncio.timeout(): await asyncio.to_thread(...) passes consistently
Defect is Python 3.11-specific and reproduced deterministically with regression test on py3.11; py3.12+ unaffected
Fix commit 8c9bf5d78d replaced asyncio.wait_for pattern with asyncio.timeout pattern to restore correct cancellation semantics and resolve all six consecutive pre-fix CI crashes
